LVGLab 0.2.0 makes the export a **drop-in replacement for a SquareLine Studio export** and adds a simulator, color themes and autosave.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `LVGLab-0.2.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.2.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.2.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.2.0-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

Unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows); no installation needed. Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once if the unsigned binary is refused.

## New

**SquareLine-compatible export**
- Same flat file layout and API as SquareLine: `ui_init`, `ui_destroy`, `ui_relocalize`,
  `ui_<Screen>_screen_init/_destroy/_relocalize`, `ui_img_<file>_png`, `ui_font_<name>`, `ui____initial_actions0`
- Configurable symbol prefix (`ui`, `sett`, …) for several UI libraries in one firmware, and a configurable library name
- Color themes: `ui_theme_set()`, `ui_theme_idx`, `UI_THEME_*`, `_ui_theme_color_*` / `_ui_theme_alpha_*`,
  `ui_object_set_themeable_style_property()`
- Multi-language texts with lv_i18n (`_("text")`)
- Byte-swapped images for `LV_COLOR_16_SWAP 1`, checked at compile time
- All font and image data is `const` and stays in flash

**Editor**
- **Simulator** (F5): click buttons, toggle switches and check boxes, drag sliders and arcs; the project's events run.
  The record mode shows the pointer and every click for screen recordings
- Color theme editor in the project settings; styles can be bound to theme colors
- Saving copies all images and fonts into an `assets/` folder next to the project
- Autosave (default every 2 minutes) with highlighted save steps in the timeline
- The AI assistant panel is available, and it knows the theme colors

**SquareLine import**
- Themes (`Themes.slt`), translatable texts, the variable prefix, multi-language mode and the byte swap of the TFT_eSPI board

## Known limitations

- SquareLine components (`.ecomp`), animations and events are not imported yet.
- The simulator switches screens without the load animation.
- LVGL 9 is not supported.
